# Code of conduct

Pons critiques artefacts and behaviour, not a person's intelligence or identity.
Use respectful, specific language and make room for different experience levels.
The project's name and examples are playful; harassment, discrimination, threats,
personal attacks and disclosure of private information are not acceptable.

Review a disputed finding by examining its evidence and counterexamples.
Treat an intentional override as useful context, not misconduct. Report harmful
conduct privately to Jonathan D.A. Jewell at j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk. The maintainer
may remove abusive material, restrict participation, and reconsider a decision
on appeal with additional evidence.
